{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the presence of '999999.99' in revenue
fraudulent_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of rows with revenue = '999999.99': {len(fraudulent_rows)}")

# Check if any rows have status 'refunded'
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Now, focus on loyal customers only
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check if any loyal customers have refunded orders
refunded_loyal = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders among loyal customers: {len(refunded_loyal)}")

# Calculate conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_df)
conversion_rate = converted_loyal / total_loyal

print(f"Converted loyal customers: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Total loyal customers: {total_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate:.4f}")"}
